evidence.title: OpenCLI — Browser Automation for AI Agents
GitHub - jackwener/OpenCLI: Make Any Website into CLI & Use your logged-in browser by AI agent. · GitHub

name: OpenCLI
summary: Browser automation CLI for AI agents: reuses your logged-in Chrome and turns 100+ sites into deterministic commands.
description: Turns your already logged-in local Chrome into a command surface for CLI workflows and AI agents — no tokens, API keys or brittle scraping. Three modes: 100+ built-in site adapters (Twitter/X, Xiaohongshu, Bilibili, Zhihu, YouTube, LinkedIn, Reddit, HackerNews and more), general-purpose browser automation (navigate, click, type, extract, screenshot) for agents, and adapter authoring for new sites. Output as JSON, CSV, Markdown or YAML; skills for Claude Code and Cursor; desktop apps (Cursor, Codex, ChatGPT App) controllable over CDP.
contains: 100+ built-in site adapters: Twitter/X, Xiaohongshu, Bilibili, Zhihu, YouTube, LinkedIn, Reddit, HackerNews
browser primitives for agents: open, network, state, eval, init, verify, screenshot
reuses Chrome's logged-in state; credentials never leave the browser
output formats: JSON, CSV, Markdown, YAML; pipeable and CI-friendly
CLI hub passthrough for gh, docker, vercel, wrangler, notion, discord, telegram; plugin system
desktop adapters (Cursor, Codex, ChatGPT App, Discord) via Chrome DevTools Protocol
Apache-2.0 licence; 30.1k GitHub stars; install with npm (Node.js >= 20) plus the Browser Bridge extension
